title: Visa extension preparation checklist
summary: A reviewed checklist of the basic facts and documents to confirm before a visa extension request.
bodyMarkdown:
## Preparation checklist

Check the current status and filing deadline before collecting documents.

- Confirm the current status of stay.
- Check the filing period and required evidence.
- Keep source documents consistent.

[Read the official guidance](https://example.test/visa)
